decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program uses existing production capacity at low incremental cost and supports service differentiation in a weak construction market, so there is no clear shortfall against aspiration that would trigger dropping it.

The 72-hour program is costlier to sustain and appears only as a mention on the website, but a large firm's slack lets it carry the program while results remain uncertain, though it is the most likely of the delivery programs to be merged or reworked.

The European-certified fire-resistant exterior door extends the core Teckentrup 62 modular system and was promoted on the home page at BAU, so it fits the core business with certification sunk costs and a strong market position.
The express program for doors and gates has its own page and links to the core product lines, so it is an established service commitment that customers expect to continue.
The online ordering and digital services platform is a strategic digitalization investment with a dedicated page, and German industry norms favor expanding such platforms rather than abandoning them.
The fire and smoke protection door belongs to the firm's core certified product range driven by building regulations, so demand is steady and dropping it would be unusual.
